attrs.statement: Ownership on ingest must be TRANSITIVE and SCHEMA-COMPLETE. Transitive: freezing a record while leaving its nested value/witness objects shared leaves an in-pass write that no store guard observes, because no set() occurs. Schema-complete: an ownership layer may sever references, it may NOT silently drop fields — dropping inputs/law_refs/naive turned alias-severing into an undeclared semantic projection over derivation_id. Owned values pass through canonicalBytes, the boundary the World already trusts, rather than a second clone algorithm; unknown spec fields are refused rather than discarded. And divergence detection may not be identity-only: a coordinator record mutated without resealing keeps a matching warrant_id, so the published VALUE is compared too.
